messages:
prod-monitor-bot: :rotating_light: HIGH ERROR RATE alert for /v1/generate (customer=acme-app). 502/500 spike starting ~1m ago. Auto-routing shows a large fraction of requests falling back to variant 'instruct-compact-v2' which is incompatible with the expected chat/json schema. Rolling error % ~38%.

infra-bot: detected fallback loop: pinned version 'redwood-chat-1@v3.2' for acme-app points to variant set that includes instruct-compact-v2 as a fallback for cost tiering. Example log snippets:
```
2026-03-15T18:02:31Z GET /v1/generate customer=acme-app route=chat gen_id=abc123 -> routed to redwood-chat-1@v3.2
2026-03-15T18:02:31Z redwood-chat-1@v3.2 fallback -> instruct-compact-v2 (incompatible) status=200 payload_type="text/plain"
2026-03-15T18:02:31Z client error: schema-mismatch when client expected chat-json -> 502
```

leah_m (oncall): 📟 acked. I'm pulling the routing policy now. Paging marco for infra assist and sasha for postmortem/impact.

marco_p: on it. Looking at routing policy: `route.acme-app.fallback_policy = cost-tier-preferred` which has instruct-compact-v2 in the candidate set. That variant is an 'instruct' flavor, not chat-compatible. Likely a bad variant catalog entry.

sasha_r: tagging cust-success for customer impact. If calls return incompatible schema customers might see 502/500s or garbage text. Need count of affected requests and timeframe.

cust-success-bot: Notified CSM: acme-app. Customer reported two high-severity errors via support / they flagged degraded search results in-prod.

leah_m (oncall): Mitigation plan (fast):
1) Remove instruct-compact-v2 from fallback candidates for acme-app (temporary policy override).
2) Unpin redwood-chat-1@v3.2 for the route so it falls back to the global default (which is chat-compatible).
3) If needed, pin explicitly to redwood-chat-1@v3.1 (known-good).
4) Monitor 1m/5m error rates and token-level schema errors.

marco_p: running emergency policy change now: `rbac run /policies/override --route acme-app --set fallback_candidates=[redwood-chat-1@v3.1, redwood-chat-1@v3.0] --reason="emergency - remove instruct variant"`

infra-bot: policy update applied (change-id: change-5489). Propagating to edge routers.

leah_m (oncall): Unpin command issued: `/routes unpin acme-app redwood-chat-1@v3.2 --force` (revertable).

tom_ops: Observability hooks added: added quick evals on a sample prompt set to ensure response JSON shape correct.

prod-monitor-bot: Metrics delta after mitigation (~3m): error rate dropped from 38% -> 2.8%. Schema-mismatch events count down 93%.

marco_p: Confirmed no more fallback to instruct-compact-v2. Edge logs show requests now landing on redwood-chat-1@v3.1 and redwood-chat-1@v3.0.

sasha_r: Customer impact summary so far: ~4.2k requests affected during window (2026-03-15T17:58:00Z - 2026-03-15T18:03:00Z). Estimated customer-facing errors ~2.1k (some retries succeeded). Classify as SEV2 with potential SEV1 if SLA credit scope expands. Will draft incident report.

leah_m (oncall): Handing off monitoring to marco for the next 30m while I go to sync with CSM and legal. TL;DR: mitigated by removing incompatible fallback, unpinning bad version, and pinning safe versions.

marco_p: taking over. I'll keep the channel updated. Next steps: schedule a quick audit of variant catalog, add a validation rule to prevent 'instruct' variants from being listed as fallbacks for chat routes, and block this routing policy in the UI until we patch.

sasha_r: Postmortem owner: sasha_r. ETA for initial postmortem draft: EOD today. Immediate action items: owners: marco_p (variant catalog fix), infra (policy validation), prod-monitoring (add alert threshold for schema-mismatch spikes).

cust-success-bot: CSM update sent to acme-app: acknowledging incident, mitigation steps, and upcoming postmortem. Will escalate if they request credits.

leah_m (oncall): Closing the active paging loop. If we see reappearance, escalate to SEV1. Thanks all for quick turn. :white_check_mark:
